payload.title: How a build-Goal run reviews its candidates within a cap: rival practices replayed from two cuts
payload.body:
Discovery Goal for issue #141, part of #113. Core scope: the run practice of a build Goal in hyp-goal-run (review, cap, stop report) and the stop clause hyp prompt prints. Aims: a review must not easily run out of the run's cap, and must not drag on over small changes. Four DesignQuestions hold the rivals, each with today's practice as a rival: record (H-one-experiment), cap (H-name-at-stop, H-reserve-last, H-raise-budget), probe (H-probe-closes), scope (H-whole-candidate). Each rival is replayed alone by a Sonnet runner (claude-sonnet-5-5): 7 Arms, 2 cuts, 3 trials each, at most 50 trials, 30 minutes per trial, in ak-skill-creator's eval flow. An Arm is a patch over skills/hyp-goal-run kept in a new recipe, never a commit to skills/. A trial prints its prompt inside its sandbox, works only in the cut store at the sandbox root, and never pushes. Combinations of the rivals that hold, and the build of the selected practice, are later Goals. Evidence: the owner's comments on #141.
May change: this repository, in commits on the branch fix/goal-run-review, with one PR the run may open or update and never merges; investigations/goal-prompt (its tree and evals), a new versioned recipe under recipes/ with its Arm patches and inputs, and docs/ where the new recipe makes a row wrong.
Read only: skills/, internal/, cmd/, every investigations/ tree except goal-prompt, ak-skill-creator under .claude/skills, and the commits b4f23b2 and 3cfd08d.
Never: commit to main or merge a PR.
Never: edit skills/, internal/ or cmd/ in this repository, or replace ~/.local/bin/hyp.
Never: write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop.
Never: let a trial push, or read or write the committed investigations/goal-prompt/.tree in its sandbox.

lines.text: [P] On cut 1 (store cut at event 01M75T1YRF2R2Z99DX0E8JQPWG, base b4f23b2, actor claude-g113-1, cap 5) a trial ends with a review Result for its final candidate, or with a stop checkpoint that names that candidate by Hypothesis id or commit as unreviewed. A review Result cites the report of a fresh subagent that read the candidate's diff. The final candidate is the Hypothesis of the last commit on the trial's branch that changes a file outside investigations/.

[P] On cut 2 (store cut at event 01M76VXNN2ZW5WAXJ194JHBCWS, base 3cfd08d, actor claude-g113-3, cap 5) a trial ends with a review Result for its final candidate, or with a stop checkpoint that names that candidate as unreviewed, as line 1 defines them. A trial that adds no commit meets this line when the cut's review of 3cfd08d stands.
[N] A select is recorded on a candidate that has no review Result, in the trial's store or its cut.
[N] A trial stops at its cap with a candidate that has no review Result and that its stop checkpoint does not name by Hypothesis id or commit.

[N] On a cut, an Arm's median trial cost is more than 1.5 times the baseline Arm's median on that cut. Cost is a trial's tokens: input, cache_read, cache_write, output and reasoning summed as ak-skill-creator's session_usage.py (sha256 863c4f39…) counts them. The median is the middle of the 3 sorted costs. A trial with no stop after 30 minutes costs the highest completed cost on that cut and fails lines 1 to 4. Baseline: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e at cap 5; each Arm's text or cap differs from it.
[N] After a review whose findings are all cases that probes pass on the candidate (probes of the trial, or ones recorded in the cut's store), the trial's branch gets a new commit.
[N] A trial's actor has more Results recorded than its Arm's cap (5; 7 for H-raise-budget), counting the Results already in the cut.
